full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media landscape painting looks along a deep, rough furrow that begins at the bottom center and narrows toward a lone dark tree on the horizon. The furrow is filled with pale muddy water, catching a thin strip of white sky, while its raised banks are built from nearly black and brown clods with coarse physical texture. On either side, low fields are scattered with countless small yellow-orange flowers and subdued green stems. Several more tiny trees and posts punctuate the far horizon, but the single larger tree marks the vanishing point. Above, a wide gray-white sky carries rubbed, scratched, and stained marks. Flecks of ocher and brown appear suspended near the top, and faint horizontal lines cross the weathered surface. The landscape is centered and almost symmetrical in its converging ground lines, yet the soil and vegetation are uneven and wild. The palette is muted and mineral: dirty white, slate gray, raw umber, dark peat, faded olive, and small sparks of yellow. A few warmer highlights lead the eye from the flowered fields toward the tree. The painted surface appears layered with grit, scraped pigment, and rough impasto, especially in the foreground earth. The sky is thinner and paler, leaving plenty of breathing room above the heavy land. No figures, structures, text, or explicit symbols are present. The image feels solemn and weather-beaten, using the long earth cut and isolated tree to hold a quiet tension between fertility, damage, and distance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形综合媒介风景绘画沿一条深而粗糙的犁沟望去：它从下方中央开始，向地平线上的一棵深色孤树逐渐收窄。沟里积着浅色泥水，接住一道白天光；两侧隆起的土岸由近黑和褐色土块组成，具有粗粝实体肌理。两边低田散着无数小黄橙花与低调绿茎。更远处几棵小树和木桩点在地平线上，但较大的那棵树标记消失点。上方宽阔灰白天空带有擦拭、刮划和污渍痕迹，顶部附近悬着赭黄和棕色碎点，风化表面横过浅浅水平线。地面汇聚线使景观居中且近乎对称，土壤和植被却高低不平而野。色板低调、矿物感强：脏白、石板灰、生褐、深泥炭色、褪色橄榄绿，以及细小黄色火花。少许暖亮点把目光从花田带向树。画面表面层叠砂砾、刮擦颜料与粗厚涂层，尤其集中在前景泥土；天空更薄、更淡，给沉重地面上方留出呼吸。没有人物、建筑、文字或明确符号。画面肃穆且经风雨，以漫长土沟和孤树在丰饶、损伤与距离之间维持安静张力。
style_prompt_en: Use a weathered mixed-media painting surface with gritty impasto, scraped pigment, stained pale grounds, and scattered fine marks. Set a heavy dark lower zone against a broad thin gray-white upper field. Guide the eye with one long central cut or converging seam that narrows toward a small distant accent. Restrict the palette to raw umber, peat black, slate gray, faded olive, dirty white, and a few ocher-yellow sparks. Allow the near surface to feel almost physically excavated while distant elements become thin and fragile. Preserve scratches and stains as part of the image's structure. The mood is austere and contemplative, with tactile material weight and expansive emptiness holding the composition together.
style_prompt_zh: 使用风化综合媒介画面表面，带砂砾厚涂、刮擦颜料、染污浅底和散落细痕。让沉重深色下部对照宽阔稀薄的灰白上部。以一道漫长中央切口或汇聚缝隙引导视线，向远处小重音逐渐收窄。色板限于生褐、泥炭黑、石板灰、褪色橄榄绿、脏白及少量赭黄色火花。近处表面几乎像实物挖掘般厚重，远处元素则变得细薄脆弱。刮痕和污迹作为图像结构保留。氛围严肃沉思，以可触材料重量和广阔空白共同维系构图。
theme_en: A muddy furrow cutting through a flowered field toward a lone tree
theme_zh: 泥泞犁沟穿过花田通向孤树
name: Anselm Kiefer
